pack.title: The library card with an old address
pack.ru: Абонемент в библиотеке со старым адресом
pack.goal: Оформить читательский билет и сообщить об изменении адреса.

grammar.title: Past Simple and present states
grammar.rule: Past Simple описывает законченные действия. Present Simple описывает текущее состояние или регулярное действие. Сравни moved и live.
grammar.pattern: I moved last month / I live here now
grammar.example: I moved in May, but I live near the library now.
grammar.pitfall: Не говори I live here last year, если речь о закончившемся периоде.
exercises: I ___ to this district last month.
Complete: My card ___ (be, present) still valid.
Скажи: я сменил адрес в мае.
I changed my address in May
Complete: I ___ (bring, past) my old card yesterday.

phrases: I moved to this district last month.
Я переехал в этот район в прошлом месяце.
My old address is still on the account.
В моём аккаунте всё ещё старый адрес.
What documents do I need to update my membership?
Какие документы нужны для обновления данных читателя?
Does this letter count as proof of address?
Подходит ли это письмо как подтверждение адреса?
How many books can I borrow at once?
Сколько книг можно взять одновременно?
When do these books have to be returned?
Когда нужно вернуть эти книги?
Can I renew a loan through the website?
Могу я продлить срок выдачи через сайт?
Please send reminders to my new email address.
Отправляйте напоминания на мой новый электронный адрес.
I brought my old library card with me.
Я принёс старый читательский билет.
The return machine is beside the lending desk.
Автомат возврата рядом со стойкой выдачи.

reading.title: The library card with an old address
paragraphs: Anna moved across town in April. Her old library card still works, but the account shows her previous address. On Wednesday she visits the library near her new flat. She wants to borrow two novels and use the quiet reading room on Saturday. She brings her card and a recent letter showing where she lives. At the lending desk, she explains that her phone number has not changed.

The librarian checks the account, explains which documents the library accepts and updates the address. Anna asks how many books she can borrow and when she must return them. The librarian shows her the due dates on a printed slip. Anna also learns that she can renew a book online if nobody else is waiting for it. Before leaving, she checks the email address on the account so that overdue reminders will go to the right place.
questions: When can she renew a book online?

dialogue: Anna
Hello. I moved in April, but my old address is still on my library account.
Здравствуйте. Я переехала в апреле, но в читательском аккаунте всё ещё старый адрес.
Librarian
Do you have your membership card and something showing your current address?
У вас есть читательский билет и документ с актуальным адресом?
Anna
Yes, I brought a recent letter. Does this count as proof of address?
Да, я принесла недавнее письмо. Оно подходит как подтверждение адреса?
Librarian
Let me check. Your membership number is unchanged, so you can keep this card.
Позвольте проверить. Номер читателя не изменился, поэтому можете сохранить этот билет.
Anna
Great. How many books can I borrow at once?
Отлично. Сколько книг можно брать одновременно?
Librarian
Your current limit is six. The due dates are printed on your slip.
Ваш текущий лимит — шесть. Сроки возврата напечатаны на квитанции.
Anna
Can I renew a loan online if I need more time?
Могу я продлить срок онлайн, если нужно больше времени?
Librarian
Yes, unless another reader has reserved the book. Check your account first.
Да, если книгу не забронировал другой читатель. Сначала проверьте аккаунт.
listening: How many books may Anna borrow at once?
speaking: Explain why an old membership address needs updating.
Ask which documents a library accepts as proof of address.
Describe the difference between moved last month and live here now.
Ask about borrowing and renewing two books.
Role-play checking the due date before leaving the library.
writing: Write a message asking a library to update your address.
Write a short account of a visit to a lending desk using Past Simple.
Write three current account details and three completed changes.
pack.model: I moved in April. My library card is still valid, but the address is wrong. Can you update my account? I brought a letter showing my new address.

competency.prerequisites: Present Simple, Past Simple, personal details
competency.canDo: Оформить читательский билет и сообщить об изменении адреса.
competency.successCriteria: Distinguish current state from dated past action; ask two membership questions; report the change accurately.

checks: I ___ my phone number in June, but my email is the same.
June is a finished past time.
Complete: She ___ (live, present) near the new branch now.
You have a library slip with a due date. What should you check before requesting a renewal?
Whether another reader reserved the book
Whether the desk is painted blue
Whether your card is made of plastic

pack.title: A receipt with a duplicate item
pack.goal: Вежливо проверить чек, объяснить ошибку и уточнить возврат денег.

grammar.title: Past Simple questions with did
grammar.rule: В вопросах о прошлом используй did + подлежащее + начальную форму. В утверждении неправильные глаголы меняют форму.
grammar.pattern: Did you scan it twice? / I bought one.
grammar.example: Did the cashier scan this item twice?
exercises: Did the cashier ___ the milk twice?
I didn't ___ two packs of cereal.
Complete: Where did you ___ (pay) for the groceries?
Скажи: я заплатил за одну бутылку.

phrases: I think this item appears twice on my receipt.
Кажется, эта позиция дважды указана в чеке.
I only bought one bottle of juice.
Я купил только одну бутылку сока.
Did the barcode scan twice at the checkout?
Штрихкод отсканировался дважды на кассе?
Could you check the transaction against my receipt?
Не могли бы вы сверить операцию с чеком?
I paid with the same card yesterday.
Я заплатил той же картой вчера.
Will the refund go back to my original payment card?
Возврат поступит на карту первоначальной оплаты?
Here is the printed total from the self-checkout.
Вот напечатанный итог с кассы самообслуживания.
I didn't notice the extra charge until I got home.
Я не заметил лишнее списание до возвращения домой.
Could I have a slip confirming the correction?
Могу я получить квитанцию, подтверждающую исправление?
Thank you for checking the duplicate entry.
Спасибо, что проверили повторную позицию.

reading.title: A receipt with a duplicate item
paragraphs: Omar went to a supermarket after work and used a self-checkout. He bought bread, milk, one bottle of juice and a few vegetables. At home, he checked the receipt because the total seemed higher than usual. The juice appeared on two separate lines, although he had only put one bottle in his bag. He kept the receipt instead of throwing it away and returned to the shop the next morning.

At the customer service desk, Omar explained what he had noticed. The assistant looked at the receipt and checked the transaction on the till system. She confirmed that the same item had been scanned twice. She processed a refund for the second charge and gave Omar a confirmation slip. Omar asked how the money would be returned and was told to check the original payment card. He did not claim that the refund had already arrived in his account.
questions: When did Omar return to the shop?

dialogue: Omar
Hello. Could you look at this receipt? I think the juice appears twice.
Здравствуйте. Не могли бы вы посмотреть этот чек? Кажется, сок указан дважды.
Assistant
Of course. Did you buy two bottles or just one?
Конечно. Вы купили две бутылки или только одну?
Omar
Just one. I used the self-checkout yesterday and noticed the extra charge at home.
Только одну. Вчера я воспользовался кассой самообслуживания и заметил лишнее списание дома.
Assistant
I'll check the transaction. Yes, the same barcode was scanned twice.
Проверю операцию. Да, один штрихкод отсканирован дважды.
Omar
Can you correct the receipt and refund the second charge?
Можете исправить чек и вернуть вторую списанную сумму?
Assistant
Yes. The refund will go back to the card you used for the purchase.
Да. Возврат поступит на карту, которой вы оплатили покупку.
Omar
Could I have a confirmation slip so I can check the refund later?
Могу получить квитанцию, чтобы позже проверить возврат?
Assistant
Certainly. Keep this with your original receipt.
Конечно. Сохраните её вместе с первоначальным чеком.
listening: Where will the refund be sent?
speaking: Describe an incorrect checkout total without accusing the cashier.
Ask three past-tense questions about the transaction.
Explain the difference between buying one item and paying for two.
Ask what evidence confirms a correction.
Role-play speaking to customer service about a receipt.
writing: Write a polite message about a duplicate grocery charge.
Write five sentences reporting what happened at a checkout yesterday.
Write three did questions and answer each using a complete past-tense sentence.
pack.model: I bought one bottle of juice, but the receipt lists two. Could you check the transaction? I paid by card, so please confirm where the refund will go.

competency.prerequisites: Past Simple regular and irregular verbs; asking prices
competency.canDo: Вежливо проверить чек, объяснить ошибку и уточнить возврат денег.
competency.successCriteria: Use did/didn't with base verbs; explain receipt discrepancy; separate refund confirmation from bank arrival.

checks: Did he ___ the correct price on the screen?
A shop processed a refund but your bank balance has not changed yet. Which statement is accurate?
The refund has been processed; arrival is not confirmed.
The bank has definitely received it.
Separate completed refund processing from bank confirmation.

pack.title: An appointment at a shoe repair shop
pack.goal: Описать повреждение, согласовать цену и срок ремонта.

grammar.title: Can / could and would like
grammar.rule: Could используется для вежливой просьбы; can — для возможности. Would like + noun/to + verb выражает желание.
grammar.pattern: Could you repair it? / I'd like to have it repaired.
grammar.example: Could you replace this heel by Friday?
grammar.pitfall: Не говори I'd like repair it: I'd like to repair it.
exercises: Complete: I'd like ___ (collect) the shoes on Friday.
I'd like ___ estimate before the repair.
Complete politely: ___ you tell me the price first? Use could.
Скажи: я хотел бы узнать дату готовности.
I would like to know the collection date

phrases: The heel is loose on the left shoe.
На левом ботинке расшатался каблук.
Could you check whether the sole needs replacing?
Можете проверить, нужно ли заменять подошву?
I'd like an estimate before you start the work.
Я хотел бы узнать предварительную цену до начала работы.
Is the leather upper still in good condition?
Кожаный верх ещё в хорошем состоянии?
Can you finish the repair by Friday afternoon?
Можете закончить ремонт к пятнице после обеда?
Please call me if the cost changes.
Позвоните мне, если стоимость изменится.
Do I pay now or when I collect the shoes?
Платить сейчас или при получении обуви?
The repair ticket shows my collection date.
В квитанции ремонта указана дата получения.
I can bring the other shoe if you need to compare them.
Могу принести второй ботинок, если нужно сравнить.
I'd rather repair this pair than buy another one.
Я предпочёл бы отремонтировать эту пару, а не покупать новую.

reading.title: An appointment at a shoe repair shop
paragraphs: Marta notices that the heel of her left work shoe moves slightly when she walks. The rest of the shoe looks fine, and the leather is comfortable, so she decides to ask a repair shop rather than buy a new pair. She brings both shoes on Monday morning. The repairer examines the heel and checks the rubber soles. He explains that the heel needs replacing, but the soles can still be used.

Marta asks for an estimate and a clear collection date. The repairer writes the expected price on a ticket and says the shoes should be ready on Thursday. He promises to contact her before doing any extra work. Marta leaves her phone number and keeps the repair ticket in her bag. On Thursday afternoon she collects both shoes, checks that the heels feel stable and pays the agreed price.
questions: The heel of the left shoe
When should the shoes be ready?

dialogue: Marta
Hello. The heel on this shoe is loose. Could you check whether it can be repaired?
Здравствуйте. На этом ботинке расшатался каблук. Можете проверить, можно ли его починить?
Repairer
Yes. The heel needs replacing, but the rest of the shoe looks fine.
Да. Каблук нужно заменить, но остальная часть обуви в порядке.
Marta
I'd like an estimate before you start. Do the soles need replacing too?
Я хотела бы узнать предварительную цену до начала. Подошвы тоже нужно заменить?
Repairer
No, the soles are still usable. The new heel will cost the amount shown here.
Нет, подошвы ещё пригодны. Новый каблук будет стоить указанную здесь сумму.
Marta
Could I collect the shoes on Thursday afternoon?
Могу забрать обувь в четверг после обеда?
Repairer
That should be possible. I'll write Thursday on the repair ticket.
Должно быть возможно. Укажу четверг в квитанции.
Marta
Please call me before doing any extra work if you find another problem.
Позвоните мне до дополнительных работ, если обнаружите другую проблему.
Repairer
Of course. Keep this ticket and pay when you collect the pair.
Конечно. Сохраните квитанцию и оплатите при получении пары.
speaking: Describe the condition of a pair of shoes in simple English.
Ask whether two different parts need replacing.
Request an estimate and agree on a collection date.
Explain whether replacing a loose heel is preferable to buying new work shoes, using the quoted cost and collection date.
Role-play asking for approval before extra work.
writing: Write a message asking for a shoe repair estimate.
Write a four-line repair ticket summary with item, problem, price and date.
Write three requests with could and two intentions with would like.
pack.model: The left heel is loose. Could you replace it? I'd like an estimate first. Please call me before doing any additional work.

competency.prerequisites: Requests with can/could, simple nouns, dates
competency.canDo: Описать повреждение, согласовать цену и срок ремонта.
competency.successCriteria: Make polite requests, describe condition, agree on repair scope and collection.

checks: I'd like ___ the bag repaired before Tuesday.
A repair shop discovers extra work after quoting a price. What can you ask?
Please confirm the new price before starting the extra work.

pack.title: A tour that changes its meeting point
pack.goal: Уточнить место встречи, время и отличить план от установленного расписания.

grammar.title: Present Continuous for arrangements
grammar.rule: Present Continuous может описывать уже согласованный будущий план. Present Simple используется для расписания.
grammar.pattern: We're meeting at ten / The tour starts at ten
grammar.example: We're meeting outside the gallery at ten.
grammar.pitfall: Не говори We meeting: нужен am/is/are.
exercises: We ___ our guide outside the gallery tomorrow.
Complete: The tour ___ (start, present simple) at ten.
Скажи: мы встречаемся у фонтана завтра.
We are meeting by the fountain tomorrow
She ___ joining us at the new meeting point.
Complete: I ___ (be, present) meeting the group at noon.

phrases: We're meeting outside the gallery instead of the town hall.
Мы встречаемся у галереи вместо ратуши.
The tour starts at ten and lasts two hours.
Экскурсия начинается в десять и длится два часа.
Have you received the meeting point update?
Ты получил обновление места встречи?
Which side of the fountain should we wait on?
С какой стороны фонтана нужно ждать?
I'm joining the group with my sister tomorrow.
Завтра я присоединяюсь к группе с сестрой.
Please show the guide your booking voucher.
Покажите гиду ваучер бронирования.
The organiser has sent a revised route map.
Организатор прислал обновлённую карту маршрута.
I'll send a message if the tram is late.
Я отправлю сообщение, если трамвай опоздает.
Does the group leave from the square at ten exactly?
Группа отправляется с площади ровно в десять?
Let's arrive a little before the departure time.
Давай придём немного раньше времени отправления.

reading.title: A tour that changes its meeting point
paragraphs: Leo and his sister book a walking tour of a historic town for Saturday morning. The booking voucher says to meet outside the town hall at ten. On Friday evening, the organiser sends a message explaining that a public event will close the square near the town hall. The group is now meeting at a fountain beside the art gallery. The starting time and the price remain the same.

Leo checks the new location on a map and replies to confirm that he received the message. His sister is arriving by tram, so he sends her the revised map rather than the old voucher. They agree to meet fifteen minutes before the tour begins. On Saturday they find the guide near the fountain, show their voucher and join the group. The guide checks the attendance list before starting the walk.
questions: Why has the meeting point changed?
A public event will close the square
When do they plan to meet?
At the end of the tour

dialogue: Leo
Hello. I received your message about a new meeting point. Are we meeting by the gallery fountain now?
Здравствуйте. Получил сообщение о новом месте встречи. Теперь встречаемся у фонтана возле галереи?
Organiser
Yes, that's right. The town hall square will be closed on Saturday morning.
Да, верно. Площадь у ратуши будет закрыта в субботу утром.
Leo
Does the tour still start at ten?
Экскурсия всё ещё начинается в десять?
Organiser
Yes. Please arrive a few minutes early and show your booking voucher.
Да. Приходите на несколько минут раньше и покажите ваучер бронирования.
Leo
My sister is coming by tram. Is there a stop near the gallery?
Сестра едет на трамвае. Возле галереи есть остановка?
Organiser
There is one across the road. Follow the signs to the fountain square.
Есть через дорогу. Следуйте указателям к площади с фонтаном.
Leo
Thanks. We're meeting at the fountain at nine forty-five, then.
Спасибо. Тогда мы встречаемся у фонтана в девять сорок пять.
Organiser
Perfect. I'll add a note that you received the update.
Отлично. Отмечу, что вы получили обновление.
listening: What does Leo plan to do at nine forty-five?
speaking: Explain a changed meeting point to a travel companion.
Contrast a tour timetable with a personal arrangement.
Ask a guide for the nearest tram stop.
Confirm a booking without confusing the original and updated location.
Describe what you will do if you arrive late.
writing: Write a short message with the revised tour meeting point and time.
Write three agreed arrangements and three fixed timetable statements.
Write a reply confirming that you received an organiser's update.
pack.model: We're meeting at the gallery fountain at nine forty-five. The tour starts at ten. I received the update and will bring the booking voucher.

competency.canDo: Уточнить место встречи, время и отличить план от установленного расписания.
competency.successCriteria: State agreed arrangements and fixed times accurately; confirm updated meeting details.

checks: We're ___ our neighbours at the park on Sunday.
Complete: The guided visit ___ (begin, present simple) at eleven.
An organiser sends a new meeting point. Which information should you pass to your companion?
The updated place and unchanged start time
A cancellation that was not announced

pack.title: A lost scarf at the community centre
pack.goal: Описать потерянный предмет, уточнить место и обстоятельства.

grammar.title: Past Continuous and Past Simple
grammar.rule: Past Continuous: was/were + -ing — процесс в момент прошлого. Past Simple — завершённое действие, в том числе событие на фоне процесса.
grammar.pattern: I was waiting when I noticed it was missing.
grammar.example: I was sitting by the door when I lost my scarf.
grammar.pitfall: Не говори I was sit: was sitting.
exercises: I ___ near the entrance when my friend called.
Complete: She was reading when she ___ (notice) the empty chair.
Скажи: я сидел рядом с дверью.
I was sitting near the door
They ___ talking when the centre closed.
Complete: I was leaving when I ___ (see) the scarf.
Скажи: мы ждали автобус, когда начался дождь.
We were waiting when the rain started

words: a seating area by the door
phrases: I was waiting by the entrance when my friend arrived.
Я ждал у входа, когда пришёл мой друг.
I noticed that my scarf was missing after the class.
Я заметил пропажу шарфа после занятия.
It has thin green stripes on a grey background.
На сером фоне тонкие зелёные полоски.
Could you check the lost property cupboard?
Можете проверить шкаф забытых вещей?
I may have left it on a cloakroom hook.
Возможно, я оставил его на крючке в гардеробе.
I was sitting in the seating area near the door.
Я сидел в зоне ожидания возле двери.
I'll leave my contact number in case someone finds it.
Оставлю контактный номер на случай, если кто-то найдёт его.
Does this description match the scarf you found?
Это описание соответствует найденному вами шарфу?
Can I collect it from reception tomorrow morning?
Могу забрать его на стойке завтра утром?
I wasn't wearing it when I left the building.
На мне его не было, когда я вышел из здания.

reading.title: A lost scarf at the community centre
paragraphs: Sofia attends a pottery class at a community centre on Tuesday evening. Before the class begins, she waits on a bench near the entrance and takes off her wool scarf. She remembers putting her bag beside her, but she does not remember putting the scarf back on. After the class, she walks home with a friend. When she reaches her flat, she notices that the scarf is missing.

The next morning Sofia calls the centre and describes the scarf. It is grey with thin green stripes and a small label at one end. The receptionist checks the lost property cupboard and finds a similar scarf. She asks Sofia to describe the label before confirming that it is the right one. Sofia explains the label and agrees to collect the scarf on Thursday. She thanks the receptionist and writes down the opening time.
questions: What was Sofia doing before class?
Where did she notice the missing scarf?
When does she agree to collect it?

dialogue: Sofia
Hello. I attended the pottery class last night, and I think I left my scarf at the centre.
Здравствуйте. Вчера вечером я была на занятии по керамике и, кажется, оставила шарф в центре.
Receptionist
Can you describe it? Where were you sitting before the class?
Можете описать его? Где вы сидели перед занятием?
Sofia
I was waiting on the bench by the entrance. The scarf is grey with thin green stripes.
Я ждала на скамейке у входа. Шарф серый с тонкими зелёными полосками.
Receptionist
We have a scarf like that in the cupboard. Is there a label at one end?
У нас есть похожий шарф в шкафу. На одном конце есть ярлык?
Sofia
Yes, a small white label with a green leaf on it.
Да, маленький белый ярлык с зелёным листом.
Receptionist
That matches the one we found. You can collect it from reception.
Это соответствует найденному шарфу. Можете забрать его на стойке.
Sofia
Thank you. Can I come on Thursday morning before work?
Спасибо. Могу прийти в четверг утром перед работой?
Receptionist
Certainly. Reception opens at eight thirty.
Конечно. Стойка открывается в восемь тридцать.
listening: Which detail helps confirm the scarf?
A white label with a green leaf
speaking: Describe a lost item using colour, material and distinctive details.
Explain what you were doing when you last saw it.
Ask a receptionist to check a lost property cupboard.
Give two possible locations without claiming certainty.
Role-play confirming ownership and arranging collection.
writing: Write a lost item report with time, location and description.
Write four sentences using was/were -ing and a short past event.
Write a message arranging collection of a found scarf.
pack.model: I was waiting near the entrance before class. My grey scarf has green stripes and a white label. Could you check lost property, please?

competency.prerequisites: Past Simple, be in past, describing objects
competency.canDo: Описать потерянный предмет, уточнить место и обстоятельства.
competency.successCriteria: Describe background and event; identify item through relevant detail; agree collection.

checks: They ___ playing cards when the phone rang.
Complete: I was packing my bag when I ___ (hear) the bell.
A lost item looks similar to yours. What helps establish ownership?
A distinctive detail you can describe
A claim that every grey scarf is yours

pack.title: A parcel that will not fit in the locker

grammar.title: Too and enough
grammar.rule: Too + adjective — чрезмерная степень; adjective + enough — достаточная степень; enough + noun — достаточное количество.
grammar.pattern: too large / large enough / enough space
grammar.example: The locker is not large enough for this box.
grammar.pitfall: Не говори enough large: large enough.
exercises: The box is ___ wide for the small locker.
Complete: The compartment is not deep ___ for this parcel.
Скажи: у нас достаточно места для коробки.
We have enough space for the box
This locker is large ___. The parcel fits.
Complete: The package is ___ heavy for this shelf. Use too.

reading.title: A parcel that will not fit in the locker
paragraphs: Adam orders a large board game as a birthday present. He chooses a parcel locker near his workplace because he often finishes late. Two days later, the delivery company sends a message saying that the package is too wide for the available compartment. The parcel has not been left in a locker, and no collection code has been issued. Adam reads the message carefully before walking to the locker.

He contacts customer service and asks whether a larger compartment is available. The agent explains that the closest locker has no suitable free space today, but a staffed collection counter is open until eight. Adam agrees to change the collection location. The agent sends a confirmation message with the new address and says that Adam should wait for a separate ready-for-collection notice. Adam checks the address and plans to visit the counter after receiving that notice.
questions: Why is the parcel not in the locker?

dialogue: Adam
Hello. The message says my parcel is too wide for the available locker. Has it arrived anywhere yet?
Здравствуйте. В сообщении сказано, что посылка слишком широкая для свободной ячейки. Она уже куда-нибудь прибыла?
Agent
It is still with the delivery service. There isn't a large enough free compartment at your chosen locker.
Она ещё у службы доставки. В выбранном постамате нет достаточно большой свободной ячейки.
Adam
Can you send it to a staffed collection counter instead?
Можете направить её в пункт выдачи с сотрудником?
Agent
Yes. There is a counter on King Street, open until eight this evening.
Да. На Кинг-стрит есть пункт, открытый сегодня до восьми вечера.
Adam
That location works for me. Do I need the old collection code?
Это место мне подходит. Нужен прежний код получения?
Agent
No code was issued. You'll receive new collection details when the parcel is ready.
Код не выдавался. Вы получите новые данные для получения, когда посылка будет готова.
Adam
Please send me the address and tell me when I can collect it.
Пришлите адрес и сообщите, когда можно будет забрать посылку.
Agent
Certainly. Wait for the ready-for-collection notice before travelling to the counter.
Конечно. Дождитесь уведомления о готовности к выдаче, прежде чем ехать в пункт.
